sentences.text: Pritam Sinha Roy vs Unknown on 7 October, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 08.10.2024  SL No.22 Court No.29  (gc)
(Rejected)
 CRM (A) 3665 of 2024  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of  the Code of Criminal Procedure read with Section 482 of the  Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection  with Shakespeare Sarani Police Station Case No.14 of 2024  dated 18.01.2024 under Sections 120B/408/420/461/471 of  the Indian Penal Code.

And  In the matter of : Pritam Sinha Roy  - Petitioner.
 Mr. Aninda Lahiri,
 Mr. Pradyut Saha,
 Ms. Ratna Dey  ....For the Petitioner.

Mr. Sandip Chakraborty,
 Mr. Chandreyi Dutta  ...
Mr. Nikunj Berlia  ....For the De facto Complainant.

1. 
The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

2. The learned Counsel for the de facto complainant and the State have submitted that a co-accused similarly placed has approached this Court and the said anticipatory bail application was rejected on 7th October, 2024.
3. We have considered the order dated 7th October, 2024 passed in CRM (A) 3670 of 2024 by which we have rejected the application for anticipatory bail.
We do not find any difference in facts for which we may take contrary view.
